title: Islamic Financial System
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the name given to the whole science of jurisprudence because it implies the exercise of intelligence in deciding a point of law in the absence of a binding text of the QURAN or SUNNNAH."
Fiqh is the name given to the whole science of jurisprudence because it implies the exercise of intelligence in deciding a point of law in the absence of a binding text of the QURAN or SUNNNAH.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are considered as the sources that originate from the text of revelation which is called textual sources or al-nass."
The Quran and Sunnah are considered as the sources that originate from the text of revelation which is called textual sources or al-nass.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the more secured form of financing for both conventional banks and IFIs."
House financing Housing finance/Mortgages is the more secured form of financing for both conventional banks and IFIs.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the financial market for short-term borrowing and lending, typically for terms of less than a year."
The money market is the financial market for short-term borrowing and lending, typically for terms of less than a year.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a financing hybrid that aims at providing cash or personal finance to a customer."
Tawarruq is a financing hybrid that aims at providing cash or personal finance to a customer.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the practice in Islamic banking to share profit with depositors."
Same is the practice in Islamic banking to share profit with depositors.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a bill of exchange, which is drawn by the bank and accepted by the purchaser, thus creating a debt owing to the bank."
Islamic accepted bill (IAB) IAB is a bill of exchange, which is drawn by the bank and accepted by the purchaser, thus creating a debt owing to the bank.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the IFSB, AAOIFI and specialized institutions that provide Islamic financial services such as rating agencies, deposit insurance corporations and mortgage corporations."
Among the key institutions are the IFSB, AAOIFI and specialized institutions that provide Islamic financial services such as rating agencies, deposit insurance corporations and mortgage corporations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the financial market for short-term financial instruments, typically those operating for less than a year."
An Islamic money market is the financial market for short-term financial instruments, typically those operating for less than a year.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a financial guarantee whereby the bank gives a pledge to a creditor on behalf of the debtor to cover fines or any other personal liability."
Kafalah is a financial guarantee whereby the bank gives a pledge to a creditor on behalf of the debtor to cover fines or any other personal liability.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an essential element which enables the instruments to be traded before their maturity."
money market instruments is an essential element which enables the instruments to be traded before their maturity.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the second key component of the money market."
Trading of money market instruments is the second key component of the money market.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an interest-free banking system which emerged in the global scene barely four decades ago."
Islamic Banking is an interest-free banking system which emerged in the global scene barely four decades ago.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible for handling the funds."
The general partner is responsible for handling the funds.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to securing and managing funds for the development of business."
Fund management refers to securing and managing funds for the development of business.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the Bank of England in 1694, which started as corporate entity i.e. as a joint stock company."
The foremost CB to be established is the Bank of England in 1694, which started as corporate entity i.e. as a joint stock company.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to an act by a person to withdraw his right to collect payment from a person who has the obligation to repay the amount borrowed from him."
Ibra refers to an act by a person to withdraw his right to collect payment from a person who has the obligation to repay the amount borrowed from him.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a component of Shari'ah and it has a close relationship with Usul- al- fiqh which comprises the principles of Islamic law."
Fiqh or Islamic law is a component of Shari'ah and it has a close relationship with Usul- al- fiqh which comprises the principles of Islamic law.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a bill of exchange, which is drawn by the exporter and accepted by the exporter's bank if the exporter's bank buys the debt from the exporter."
IAB-Export of Sales is a bill of exchange, which is drawn by the exporter and accepted by the exporter's bank if the exporter's bank buys the debt from the exporter.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means of Islamic finance are based on trading."
The principal means of Islamic finance are based on trading.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the Islamic counterpart of conventional insurance, and exists both in life (or "family") and general forms."
Takaful is the Islamic counterpart of conventional insurance, and exists both in life (or "family") and general forms.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a rabb al-mal or investor who provides the capital and a mudarib or the entrepreneur who will manage the project."
The parties are a rabb al-mal or investor who provides the capital and a mudarib or the entrepreneur who will manage the project.
fib: ______ refers to the sale of a debt arising from a transaction in the form of a deferred payment sale.
Bay al-dayn
Bay al-dayn refers to the sale of a debt arising from a transaction in the form of a deferred payment sale.
______ is the most important function of Islamic money market.
Liquidity management
Liquidity management is the most important function of Islamic money market.
______ is an Islamic International autonomous non- profit organization that prepares an accounting, auditing, governance, ethics and Shari'ah standards for IFIs, participants and overall industry.
AAOIFI
AAOIFI is an Islamic International autonomous non- profit organization that prepares an accounting, auditing, governance, ethics and Shari'ah standards for IFIs, participants and overall industry.
______ refer to the act of buying and selling of government securities by the central bank to influence liquidity and interest rates in the financial system.
Open market operations
Open market operations refer to the act of buying and selling of government securities by the central bank to influence liquidity and interest rates in the financial system.
______ is a means for conducting transactions and not a commodity to be traded.
Money
Money is a means for conducting transactions and not a commodity to be traded.
______ refer to products which have their origin from the conventional market and are "Islamized" by modifying it to suit the Shari'ah requirements.
Shari'ah-compliant products
Shari'ah-compliant products refer to products which have their origin from the conventional market and are "Islamized" by modifying it to suit the Shari'ah requirements.
______ is the same as in the case of the conventional model, i.e .central bank undertakes open market operations by undertaking Repurchase Agreements and reverse Repurchase Agreements (REPOs).
mechanism
The mechanism is the same as in the case of the conventional model, i.e .central bank undertakes open market operations by undertaking Repurchase Agreements and reverse Repurchase Agreements (REPOs).
______ is an underlying basis for the Islamic economic system as some medium is necessary for a store of value in order for individuals to engage in the exchange of goods and services.
Possessing a store of value

Possessing a store of value is an underlying basis for the Islamic economic system as some medium is necessary for a store of value in order for individuals to engage in the exchange of goods and services.
______ means to stop, contain, or preserve.
Waqf in Arabic
Waqf Waqf in Arabic means to stop, contain, or preserve.
______ is an organization that performs all the typical functions of financial intermediation while retaining its Islamic character.
Islamic financial institution
An Islamic financial institution is an organization that performs all the typical functions of financial intermediation while retaining its Islamic character.

______ refers to a mechanism whereby a deficit Islamic banking institution ("investee bank") can obtain investment from a surplus Islamic banking institution ("investor bank") based on the Mudarabah principle.
MII

MII refers to a mechanism whereby a deficit Islamic banking institution ("investee bank") can obtain investment from a surplus Islamic banking institution ("investor bank") based on the Mudarabah principle.
______ is the body mandated by the laws of Nigeria to license, regulate and supervise banks, therefore Islamic banking institutions fall under its regulatory purview.
central bank
The central bank is the body mandated by the laws of Nigeria to license, regulate and supervise banks, therefore Islamic banking institutions fall under its regulatory purview.
______ is an industry that offers financial intermediation services based on compliance with the Islamic law (Shari'ah).
Islamic finance industry
The Islamic finance industry is an industry that offers financial intermediation services based on compliance with the Islamic law (Shari'ah).
______ is the most common method of raising funds.
Issuing a debt instrument
Issuing a debt instrument is the most common method of raising funds.
______ is referred to as an obligation which arises from a bilateral relationship between two parties.
contract ('aqd)
contract
A contract ('aqd) is referred to as an obligation which arises from a bilateral relationship between two parties.
______ is a complex set of financial institutions and markets that bring together lenders and borrowers consisting of banks, insurance companies, mutual funds and other finance companies.
financial system
A financial system is a complex set of financial institutions and markets that bring together lenders and borrowers consisting of banks, insurance companies, mutual funds and other finance companies.
______ refers to a contract that allows the debtor to transfer his debt obligation to a third party.
Hiwalah
Hiwalah refers to a contract that allows the debtor to transfer his debt obligation to a third party.
______ is known as Aqd in Arabic which means 'to tie' or 'to knot' or 'to join'.
contract
A contract is known as Aqd in Arabic which means 'to tie' or 'to knot' or 'to join'.
______ is defined as the banking system that is consistent with Islamic principles and guided by Islamic economics.
Islamic bank
Islamic bank is defined as the banking system that is consistent with Islamic principles and guided by Islamic economics.
______ is a financial market where existing securities are bought and sold.
secondary market
A secondary market is a financial market where existing securities are bought and sold.
______ is the feature of commercial financial contracts based on interest, where interest is seen as both the price of an underlying product or credit and cost of money.
creditor-debtor relationship
a) The creditor-debtor relationship is the feature of commercial financial contracts based on interest, where interest is seen as both the price of an underlying product or credit and cost of money.
______ is responsible for managing the funds and providing returns to the investors.
fund manager
The fund manager is responsible for managing the funds and providing returns to the investors.
According to the course material, how many elements of a valid contract are there? (answer in figures)
three

There are three elements of a valid contract: --The form of the contract (sighah); which comprises of the offer (ijab) and acceptance (qabul). -The contracting parties (al-qidayn) and - The subject matter (al-ma'qud 'alayh) i.e the commodities to be transacted.
